subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new pinned revisions of openai/codex-action and actions/create-github-app-token for workflows that pass an OpenAI API key or GitHub App private keys?
rationale: This is an intentional third-party code-trust decision at secret and credential boundaries; it cannot be safely inferred from Dependabot metadata or ordinary CI results.

options.title: Audit and approve the grouped revisions
options.body: Inspect the exact upstream commits for the secret-bearing actions, accept the trust change explicitly, then rebase and merge only after required checks finish.

options.title: Split privileged action upgrades
options.body: Merge only action revisions without secret or credential access and handle Codex/App-token action changes in a separately audited PR.

options.title: Hold the dependency group
options.body: Close or defer this grouped update until a security owner can review the privileged action revisions.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the grouped revisions
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact upstream commits for the secret-bearing actions, accept the trust change explicitly, then rebase and merge only after required checks finish.
